thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a spike in SLA violations where leads are skipping the SalesRR round-robin after enrichment delays. 12% of claims >10m this morning :eyes:

tyler: Is this correlated with the enrichment job failures? Any sample HS IDs?

maria: Quick sample: hs_id 789123, 789124, 789130. enrichment_completed flag was null for ~20m then flipped and assignment never entered rotation. Dashboard shows a big gap around 06:12–06:45 UTC.

jamal: We rolled out a HubSpot workflow tweak last night to only assign once enrichment_completed == true. Could be a race where enrichment finishes but the workflow misses the event. I pushed a small retry in the worker but maybe not enough.

sophia: SFDC mapping might be part of this — if owner mapping fails we fallback to the legacy default owner which is exempt from RR. I'll pull the mapping error rates.

ops-bot: alert: lead-routing.sla > threshold 10m for queue SalesRR — 12.1% (1h) — see metrics link: https://console.redwood/metrics/lead-routing/sla

maria: Thanks. Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) enable a short-time fallback that puts these leads into the unassigned queue (so SDRs can claim manually) 2) run a backfill reassign job to push missed leads into RR 3) add a 5-min webhook retry for enrichment-complete events. Thoughts?

tyler: +1 on fallback + backfill. I'll open a HubSpot workflow patch to add a "wait 5m then re-evaluate" step. Example condition snippet I plan to add:
```
IF enrichment_completed == true THEN ASSIGN_TO_ROUTER
ELSE WAIT 5 minutes -> RE-EVALUATE
```

jamal: I'll schedule the backfill job now. SQL I use to find missed leads: 
```sql
SELECT id FROM leads
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND enrichment_completed = true
  AND assigned_at IS NULL;
```
I'll run with a 10m stagger to avoid burst.

sophia: I'll update the SLA dashboard to show "assignment attempt" vs "assignment success" as separate metrics so we can see whether workflows fired but failed mapping. Also adding a short-term alert at 7% to catch early.

maria: Jamal — can you run a dry run and post counts? Tyler — aim to deploy the HS workflow patch in the 30m maintenance window. Sophia — update dashboard by EOD.

jamal: Dry run: 184 leads found, ~60 look like enrichment-lag cases, 124 were mapping failures. Posting the CSV in #marketing-ops channel.

tyler: Created PR: hubspot/workflows#542 — adds retry + log hook. Scheduling deploy at 06:50 UTC.

ops-bot: deployment: hubspot/workflows#542 scheduled for 06:50 UTC by tyler

sophia: Dashboard updated with "assignment_attempt" metric and temporary 7% alert. Historical baseline captured.

maria: Great — after deploy we'll let the backfill run and monitor the SalesRR SLA. If mapping failures persist, we need an owner-mapping fallback to a small pool rather than single default owner.

jamal: Backfill started at 06:55 UTC, rate-limit is 20 leads/min. ETA ~9 minutes.

tyler: Deploy succeeded. Logs show retry hook firing for 58/60 enrichment-lag cases.

ops-bot: alert: lead-routing.sla now 4.8% (15m) — trending down

sophia: Nice, the assignment_attempt vs success diff narrowed — mapping errors still present but much reduced.

maria: Action items captured: (1) tyler: keep HS workflow retry + add logging (2) jamal: finish CSV backfill and create nightly consistency check (3) sophia: add permanent dashboard panel for mapping failures and set QoS alert (4) marketing ops: update handoff playbook to include manual claim fallback.

tyler: Will follow up with a tiny logging PR to capture owner mapping failure reasons.

jamal: Backfill complete at 07:04 UTC — moved 180 leads into RR, verified 160 claimed within 10m window.

maria: Thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now. Will keep monitoring next 24h and loop in platform if mapping errors increase. :thumbsup: :rocket:
